name: Pinacosuchus
isnote: Gilmore (1942) considered and rejected a pseudosuchian thecodont identity; the specimen is too fragmentary for a finer placement (English Wikipedia).
sum: Pinacosuchus is a small crocodylomorph with spiky dermal armour, known from limited remains from the Maastrichtian North Horn Formation of Utah.
wsnote: Small-bodied; the sacrum of USNM 16592 is only 14.3 mm long; no body length is given.
holotype: USNM 16592: a fragment of upper jaw, several vertebrae and armour, from the North Horn Formation, Utah.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Gilmore 1942

sources.text: C. W. Gilmore. 1942. A new fossil reptile from the Upper Cretaceous of Utah. Proceedings of the United States National Museum 93(3158):109-114
